properties.description: Class invariants over every node of six designs (π+e, Arrow, Brocard, the proof of concept's case 1 slice of reflow2, and proof-trial rungs 1 and 2): every standing measured TemporalFact holds and one made superseded, invalidated or a forecast reads unknown; no ChangeEvent reads false; a counter-argument recorded as its own statement is answered there; every accepted Decision a step concludes reads its acceptance beside its chain and says its `chose`; a first incomplete chain never reads the decision unsupported and the walk shows `accepted_without_a_holding_chain`; no discharged assumption is unsupported; no deliberate objection is a contradiction and an accidental one still is; a settled reinstatement chain is not a defect while an unargued mutual attack or odd cycle is; every conditional claim reads `truth: conditional`; the served skills agree a Decision may be a chain's conclusion.
properties.name: a_premise_has_a_truth_and_a_proof_reads_correct.rs — the records a choice rests on carry a truth, and a correct proof reads correct, on six designs
